name: 95210 · Stockton, CA
findings: ZIP 95210 (Stockton) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95210 (Stockton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95210 (Stockton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).
